vision.name: Red Commanding Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled energy attacks deal +1 life card of damage. After one of your attacks lowers your anger, raise your anger 1 level.
[Instant] POWER: Use when an MP changes levels from one of your Styled cards or effects. Use a critical damage effect.
POWER: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, Rejuvenate the bottom card of your discard pile. If that card is an attack, you may play it instead.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; number area reads 'PREVIEW DR25' (zoomed); DR number printed
